design.summary: A 4WD mobile robot equipped with a linear actuator lift arm and submersible pump system to water plants on the floor, table, and high shelf.

reasons.chassis-4wd-m: Provides a sturdy 4WD base with a 3000g payload capacity to carry the heavy linear actuator mast and water tank.
reasons.pi4b-4gb: Serves as the main robot controller for processing and controlling hardware.
reasons.md-motor-hat: Provides 4 motor drive channels over I2C to control wheels, linear actuator mast, and water pump.
reasons.arm-lact10p: Gives a 606mm vertical lift to reach the high plant shelf at 650mm height.
reasons.tool-pump-submersible: Compact DC submersible pump to deliver water from the tank to each plant.
reasons.tank-500: Holds 500ml of water, providing more than enough capacity to deliver 100ml to each of the three plants.
reasons.bat-nimh-2200: 7.2V rechargeable battery pack delivering ample current and over 40 minutes of runtime.
reasons.reg-5v-3a: Steps down 7.2V battery output to a stable 5V at up to 3.2A to power the Raspberry Pi.
